baseline_comparator: Frozen Ticket 1 raw-text TF-IDF plus Logistic Regression baseline
selection_rule: Do not adopt a feature merely for higher dev F1. Require favorable error movement, an interpretable mechanism, and acceptable behavior when the relevant metadata or superficial surface signals are neutralized. Prefer the simplest defensible representation; reject gains dominated by sparse location identities or brittle metadata availability.

variants.name: train_majority_floor
variants.hypothesis: Provides a no-signal wiring floor and should have target-1 F1 zero.

variants.name: raw_text_tfidf_logistic_regression
variants.hypothesis: Provides the frozen legitimate content baseline.

variants.name: keyword_only
variants.hypothesis: Keywords carry strong topical signal but are mixed evidence because they are benchmark-provided retrieval metadata rather than tweet prose.

variants.name: length_only
variants.hypothesis: Length can separate reporting styles but is primarily a shallow dataset artifact and should be weak alone.

variants.name: keyword_plus_length
variants.hypothesis: Length may add complementary style information to keyword, but any gain may remain shortcut-prone.

variants.name: location_only
variants.hypothesis: Sparse user-entered locations should be weak and brittle; apparent signal is likely a dataset artifact.

variants.name: keyword_plus_location
variants.hypothesis: Location may add memorized identity-like categories to keyword but should not be trusted without robust evidence.

variants.name: selected_shallow_only
variants.hypothesis: Counts, ratios, missingness, and length may expose benchmark construction artifacts but should remain weaker than semantic text.

variants.name: text_plus_keyword
variants.hypothesis: Keyword may complement tweet text and improve dev performance, but the model should be audited under keyword masking before adoption.

variants.name: text_plus_selected_shallow_features
variants.hypothesis: Adding keyword plus length, surface counts, and missingness may improve the visible split; adoption requires that the gain not be explained by brittle fields or superficial formatting.

missing_value_policy.keyword: SimpleImputer constant __MISSING_KEYWORD__ fitted inside the training pipeline
missing_value_policy.location: SimpleImputer constant __MISSING_LOCATION__ fitted inside the training pipeline

perturbations: neutralize URLs, mentions, hashtag markers, punctuation, and casing in text

signal_classification_priors.full_location_categories: dataset artifact unless strong contrary evidence
